LAW-0025: baseline-es preset, every ratio, t>=0.72 through the hold: the reviewer's stamp text 'ALINEADO' breaks in the middle of the word as 'ALINEAD' / 'O' (seen at 16:9 t=1 and 9:16 t=1).
